plan.notes: Source: 'BA/MAT Modern Languages: English Education 4+1 Program - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of Modern Languages), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. 4+1 program: 108 undergraduate + 30 graduate hours = 138 total. Graduate MAT courses are sequenced alongside undergraduate courses. Semester 7 is labeled 'Fall - Semester 7 (Conditional Admission to EPP)' and is kept verbatim. Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true. The Fall Semester 5 slot prints 'ENGL 3583 Shakespeare or ENGL 4313 Major Authors' - ENGL 4313 does not appear in the program requirements list; kept verbatim.
